newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police say Naples mob boss arrested.
newsitem.headline: Italian police say Naples mob boss arrested.

text.p: Italian police said on Friday they had arrested the suspected head of the Naples-based Camorra crime group.
Police said agents from the DIA anti-Mafia police force had surprised Marzio Sepe as he waited to meet someone outside an abandoned cottage in the countryside east of Naples on Wednesday night.
Sepe, 42, who had been a fugitive for four years, tried to run away but was captured, they said.

Police said Sepe had been wanted on 15 arrest warrants for charges ranging from Mafia association to extortion and murder and had recently been sentenced in his absence to life in prison following a murder conviction.
Investigators said they believed Sepe succeeded Carmine Alfieri as boss of the Camorra following Alfieri's arrest in September 1992.
